description: Smarte Strasse: Verkehrslärm is a dataset listed in Datenportal Basel-Stadt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Amt für Umwelt und Energie. Das Amt für Umwelt und Energie (AUE) testet im Rahmen des Projekts «Smarte Strasse» einen akustischen Sensor bezüglich Funktionalität, Genauigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit. Der Lärmsensor erfasst Umgebungsgeräusche und erkennt mittels künstlicher Intelligenz die individuellen Lärmprofile verschiedener Fahrzeuge. Coverage: Canton of Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport, Tourism. Its keywords are Lärm, Smarte Strasse. The portal shows 144,229 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2024-02-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bs-ch-portal.
